description: Implementation of the QueryVk class for Vulkan queries in ANGLE, handling query lifecycle, result retrieval, and transform feedback integration.

classes.name: QueryVk
classes.description: Class implementing Vulkan query operations, including starting, ending, retrieving results, and handling transform feedback.

methods.name: QueryVk
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QueryVk object with a specific query type.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up query resources when the query object is destroyed.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts the query, handling special cases like transform feedback and timestamp queries.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the query, updating cached results and handling transform feedback.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the query result, waiting if necessary, and processes results based on query type.

methods.name: getResult (overloads)
methods.description: Retrieves the query result as specific data types (GLint, GLuint, GLint64, GLuint64).

methods.name: isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the query result is available.

methods.name: onTransformFeedbackEnd
methods.description: Updates primitives drawn count when transform feedback ends.
